# OLO NSE Parquet dataset

> Query-ready National Stock Exchange of India historical daily OHLCV, delivery quantity, delivery percentage, and one-minute OHLCV data organized by symbol in Parquet files.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/olo-labs/olo-testdata-parquet

## Primary documentation

- [Repository overview](README.md): scope, layout, schema, build commands, and viewer.
- [Dataset card](docs/DATASET.md): intended uses, scope, sources, limitations, and reproducibility.
- [File structure](docs/FILE_STRUCTURE.md): exact symbol partition and filename rules.
- [Data dictionary](docs/DATA_DICTIONARY.md): eight Parquet columns, types, nullability, and semantics.
- [Quick start](docs/QUICKSTART.md): DuckDB, Python, pandas, Polars, and aggregation queries.
- [OLO DB Viewer snapshot](docs/assets/olo-db-viewer-snapshot.png): current visual reference for the desktop database checker; replace in place when the UI changes.
- [Data quality](docs/DATA_QUALITY.md): validation SQL and known limitations.
- [FAQ](docs/FAQ.md): direct answers to common NSE dataset questions.
- [Builder](parquet_database/README.md): incremental build, verification, releases, and adapters.
- [Dataset metadata](metadata/dataset.jsonld): Schema.org JSON-LD.
- [Citation metadata](CITATION.cff): repository citation details.
- [Contribution guide](CONTRIBUTING.md): generated-data and validation conventions.

## Critical facts

- Consumer paths: `database/<lowercase-first-character>/<symbol>/day.parquet` and `1m.parquet`.
- Ordered schema: `timestamp TIMESTAMP, open DOUBLE, high DOUBLE, low DOUBLE, close DOUBLE, volume BIGINT, delivery BIGINT, del_percent DOUBLE`.
- Daily files contain delivery quantity and delivery percentage when supplied upstream.
- Minute files intentionally have null `delivery` and `del_percent`.
- Row order is not guaranteed; always sort/order by `timestamp`.
- Symbols are encoded in paths and are not repeated as a Parquet column.
- The project is independent and is not affiliated with or endorsed by NSE; it is not investment advice.
